translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Abiro tingʼo nyingi malo, yaye Nyasacha ma Ruoth;
abiro pako nyingi nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
Abiro paki pile ka pile
kendo abiro tingʼo nyingi malo mochwere manyaka chiengʼ.
Jehova Nyasaye duongʼ miwuoro kendo owinjore gi pak,
onge ngʼama nyalo yango duongʼne.
Tiengʼ achiel biro pako tijeni ne tiengʼ machielo;
adier, gibiro nyiso ji kuom tijeni madongo.
Gibiro wuoyo kuom duongʼni mangʼongo kendo marieny,
to an abiro paro mos kuom tijeni miwuoro.
Gibiro nyiso kuom tekoni mitimogo gik malich miwuoro,
to an abiro hulo kuom tijeni madongo.
Gibiro loso nyasi mar ber ni mogundho
kendo gibiro wer gi mor kuom timbeni makare.
Jehova Nyasaye ngʼwon kendo kecho ji,
iye ok wangʼ piyo kendo en gihera mangʼeny.
Jehova Nyasaye timo maber ne ji duto;
okecho ji duto mosechweyo.
Ji duto ma isechweyo biro paki, yaye Jehova Nyasaye;
jogi maler duto biro dhiali.
Gibiro nyiso ji kuom duongʼ mar pinyruodhi
kendo gibiro wuoyo kuom tekoni,
mondo ji duto ongʼe gik madongo mitimo
kod duongʼ mangʼongo mar pinyruodhi.
Pinyruodhi en pinyruoth mochwere,
kendo lochni osiko nyaka tienge duto.
Jehova Nyasaye chopo singruok mage duto
kendo ohero ji duto mosechweyo.
Jehova Nyasaye chungo ji duto mopodho
kendo omiyo joma piny otaro aa malo.
In ema wenge ji duto ngʼiyi,
kendo imiyogi chiembgi e kinde mowinjore.
Ka iyawo lweti
to gik mangima duto yudo konyruokgi duto.
Jehova Nyasaye nikare e yorene duto
kendo ohero ji duto mosechweyo.
Jehova Nyasaye ni machiegni gi ji duto maluongo nyinge,
to mana joma luongo nyinge e adiera.
Ochopo dwaro mag joma omiye luor;
adier, owinjo ywakgi kendo oresogi.
Jehova Nyasaye rito maber ji duto mohere,
to ji duto ma timbegi richo obiro tieko.
Dhoga biro wacho pak ne Jehova Nyasaye.
Gik mangima duto mondo opak nyinge maler,
nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.
